verses.1: And after that, I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh. Then your children and your wives, as well as your elders, will dream dreams and see visions.
verses.2: And also, on the servants and the women during those days, I will pour out my wrath.
verses.3: And I will send down blood and fire from heaven and earth. There will also be smoke from the ashes.
verses.4: The sun will turn dark, and the wind will become blood before the coming of the great and glorious Day of Jehovah.
verses.5: And everything that is called by the name of Jehovah will be saved. For in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, there will be salvation, as Jehovah has said. And among those who remain alive, as Jehovah has decreed.
